baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَتَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّلْمِ ... وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The coordinated prohibitions link loss of resolve to initiating a spoken movement toward armistice while the addressees occupy a position of ascendancy. The danger is not peace in the abstract but a peace initiative coupled to collapse while leverage remains.

activation_trace.role: Weakness of force and slackening of resolve supplies the internal failure blocked by the prohibition.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the outward initiative joined to that failure.
Armistice and mutual peace as the opposite of war names the destination of the call.
Prevailing and taking control makes the while-clause a live condition of retained leverage.

changed_reading.before: A categorical command never to make peace.
changed_reading.after: A command not to let weakened resolve issue in a peace initiative while advantage is still held.

baseline_models.mechanism: The surrender and handover branch of س ل م gives the proposed peace a transfer edge. Calling toward it while prevailing can mean inviting the relinquishment of an affair still under the addressees' control, so this reading coexists with ordinary armistice rather than replacing it.

activation_trace.role: A verbal call supplies the deliberate invitation into a new relation.
Handing a thing over, abandoning it, or leaving it supplies the surrender-like cost latent in the destination.
Control and prevalence make such a handover premature rather than unavoidable.

changed_reading.before: Peace is only a neutral cessation of fighting.
changed_reading.after: The prohibited call can also be heard as inviting surrender or transfer of what remains under the community's control.

baseline_models.mechanism: The negative future promise is explicit accounting: purposeful acts and the laborer's due will not be docked. Divine accompaniment is therefore rendered as protection against loss of accumulated work, not only as an undefined feeling of support.

activation_trace.role: A deficiency that strips a right or work supplies the precise threatened deduction negated by لَن.
Intended action supplies the accumulated substance that will not be diminished.
The wage or provision of a worker activates a recompense ledger behind the promise of no deduction.

changed_reading.before: God's presence is followed by a generic promise of help or reward.
changed_reading.after: God's presence includes a concrete non-loss guarantee: neither intentional labor nor its due will be shortchanged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier conflict sequence moves from restraint to release or ransom and finally makes war itself lay down its burdens. This revises the focus prohibition away from perpetual hostility: it opposes the addressees' weakness-driven attempt to author cessation while advantage remains, not a legitimate cessation whose sequence and conditions have arrived.

activation_trace.role: Slackened force and resolve keeps the revised model anchored in the prohibited internal condition.
Peace as the opposite of war remains the focus destination whose timing is being revised.
Uncompensated release supplies one explicit post-restraint disposition rather than endless retention.
Ransoming a captive supplies the coexisting alternative disposition after restraint.
Putting something into a lower or settled place supplies the downward terminal motion assigned to war.
The specific burdens of war name the load that war eventually sets down.

structural_cues: 47:4 orders disposition through حَتَّىٰ and فَإِمَّا ... وَإِمَّا before making war the subject of تَضَعَ; 47:35 instead forbids the addressees' own call while they are uppermost.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit war-ending clause and post-restraint alternatives; I infer that actor and sequence distinguish timely cessation from a weakness-driven call. A live alternative is that 47:35 simply suspends peace-seeking during its immediate campaign phase.

changed_reading.before: Do not seek peace because conflict itself must continue.
changed_reading.after: Do not prematurely initiate peace from failing resolve; conflict still has a packet-supplied endpoint and non-combat dispositions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal aid stabilizes feet, divine patronage is asymmetrically present, and a town of greater assembled force is destroyed without a helper. The focus superiority is thus not reducible to headcount or matériel; it is a maintained, relational stance whose leverage depends on support and steadiness.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing and control supplies the focus claim whose basis is being reclassified.
Aid that makes another prevail supplies the reciprocal support relation in the if-then construction.
Strengthening and fixing something supplies the maintenance that prevents positional collapse.
Literal feet turn superiority into embodied footing rather than a detached rank.
Love, support, and alliance supply the patronage present for one side and denied to the other.
Strength assembled like strands of a rope supplies the greater raw force that nevertheless fails.
The absent helper makes lack of support, rather than lack of force, decisive in the comparison.

structural_cues: 47:7 uses reciprocal conditional support, 47:11 contrasts having and lacking a mawla, and 47:13 explicitly says the destroyed town was stronger yet had no helper.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies force, support, footing, and patronage as separable variables; I infer that support-mediated stability is the arrow from divine accompaniment to being uppermost. A live alternative is that الأعلى simply reports immediate battlefield advantage.

changed_reading.before: You are uppermost because you possess greater material force.
changed_reading.after: You occupy a supported and stabilized position that can outrank greater material force, but that position remains relational rather than inherent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context stages a failure between voiced readiness and costly enactment: mention of fighting produces restricted motion and a death-like loss of awareness, while a resolved command requires truthful fulfillment and later testing exposes strenuous effort, held composure, and inner report. Do not weaken therefore targets decision integrity at the transition from speech to action, not the mere occurrence of fear.

activation_trace.role: Slackened resolve is the focus condition now exposed as a transition failure.
Weakening an affair and restricting movement supplies the impaired response when fighting is named.
A faint that covers awareness literalizes visible collapse at the moment of costly command.
The split inventory's covering of understanding sharpens the collapse as impaired apprehension, not only bodily tiredness.
Loss of force and life supplies the terminal image toward which the gaze approaches.
Binding and decisively cutting the heart onto an affair supplies the threshold where speech must become action.
Making a promise true in action supplies the required continuity across that threshold.
Expending capacity under hardship supplies enacted resolve rather than verbal appetite.
Holding the self back from panic supplies composure without requiring emotional numbness.
Knowledge of report and inner reality makes the trial an exposure of what declared readiness concealed.

structural_cues: 47:20 moves from a request for revelation to a death-like gaze when fighting is mentioned; 47:21 marks the moment when the affair becomes resolved; 47:31 repeats emphatic testing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies desire, visible collapse, resolved command, truthful enactment, and exposure; I infer a causal gap between saying and doing as the relevant form of wahn. A live alternative is that the focus addresses battlefield morale more narrowly.

changed_reading.before: Do not experience fear, fatigue, or softness.
changed_reading.after: Do not let fear or fatigue break the passage from declared commitment to truthful action when the command becomes costly and revealing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Works can fall through alignment with what provokes divine anger, believers are warned not to nullify their own works, and wages are then promised. The focus guarantee is therefore covenantal accounting: God does not underpay or confiscate faithful labor, while agents can still drive their work into invalidity.

activation_trace.role: Stripping a right or diminishing work supplies the deduction that God explicitly negates.
Purposeful action supplies the ledger object whose preservation is at issue.
A worker's wage supplies the recompense side of the ledger.
Anger as the opposite of approval supplies the adverse alignment preceding the fall of works.
Descent and falling supplies the collapse that work can undergo through adverse alignment.
Removing and invalidating a thing supplies the addressees' own prohibited action toward their works.
Recompense for labor supplies the positive payment promised immediately after the focus.

structural_cues: أَعْمَٰل recurs through 47:28, 47:30, 47:32, 47:33, and 47:35, with an imperative not to nullify it before the non-deduction promise and an أجور promise after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both divine non-deduction and humanly caused invalidation; I infer a two-sided ledger in which preservation governs God's side while alignment governs the work's viability. A live alternative is to read each work formula as an independent promise or warning without a single accounting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: All deeds attributed to the addressees are unconditionally protected from loss.
changed_reading.after: God will not shortchange viable faithful work, but the addressees can still nullify its value through their own contrary alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same call-root reverses agency across the focus and the closing ayah: the community is forbidden to issue one call toward peace and is then itself called to send wealth outward in God's path. Withholding returns against the self, while self-sufficient God can replace the group. The focus becomes a contest over who sets the summons and whether the community redirects resources into disengagement or answers costly mobilization.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech supplies the community-authored summons in the focus.
Armistice supplies the direction chosen by that first summons.
The repeated call now targets the community itself and reverses it from caller to called.
Money going outward in expenditure supplies the costly direction of the answering movement.
Repeated miserliness supplies the refusal to answer the second summons.
The self or very same person supplies the destination against which withholding rebounds.
Self-sufficiency removes divine need as the reason for the summons.
Need and scant means relocates dependence onto the human addressees.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the consequence for refusing the call.
A group of people supplies the replaceable collective slot, qualifying any inherent claim to superiority.

structural_cues: Active تَدْعُوا in 47:35 is mirrored by passive تُدْعَوْنَ in 47:38, and the closing conditional links turning away to collective replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated call-root, reversed grammatical agency, expenditure, withholding, and replacement; I infer that call-authority and resource direction form one mobilization mechanism. A live alternative is that the economic appeal is adjacent exhortation that does not redefine the military command.

changed_reading.before: The focus regulates only whether leaders verbally propose an armistice.
changed_reading.after: The focus also participates in a contest of summons: do not author disengagement while being called to costly collective expenditure, since refusal harms the self and can forfeit the group's place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly moves hidden states outward: secrets are kept, inner hostility is brought out, people are recognized by marks, and implication bends through the tone of speech. A call toward peace can therefore be read diagnostically as a speech act whose latent source matters. Identical policy content may be prudent in one sequence and an audible symptom of wahn in another.

activation_trace.role: A spoken call supplies the focus act that can carry more than its explicit proposal.
Concealing something inwardly supplies the latent motive beneath public speech.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the first exposure movement.
A visible mark from which a viewer infers condition supplies an external diagnostic sign.
Inclining speech toward its implication supplies the audible route from utterance to concealed stance.
A second bringing-out under pressure closes the hidden-to-visible mechanism.

structural_cues: The branchless ض غ ن occurrences at 47:29 and 47:37 form a concealed-to-exposed chain and are used only structurally; 47:30 places recognition in both visible marks and the inflection of speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, exposure, marks, and speech-inflection; I infer that motive can determine whether the focus call manifests prudent timing or weakening. A live alternative is that these diagnostics apply only to the specifically duplicitous speakers in 47:26-30.

changed_reading.before: The explicit content of a peace proposal alone determines whether it violates the command.
changed_reading.after: The proposal is also diagnostic speech: its sequence, motive, and inflection can reveal whether it arises from prudence or latent collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement promises wages, limits the demand for wealth, imagines pressure exposing miserliness, and declares God self-sufficient while humans are needy. God's being with the addressees is therefore supportive presence without divine dependency: the self-sufficient patron preserves their due but does not need their resources.

activation_trace.role: The divine name identifies the accompanying party whose relation is being qualified.
Non-diminution of a right supplies the patron's guarantee against underpayment.
The worker's wage supplies the economic shape of the protected due.
Payment for labor confirms that the relation includes recompense flowing toward the addressees.
Asking or requesting supplies the demand for wealth that the text first negates.
Exhaustive insistence supplies the counterfactual pressure that would expose miserliness.
Independence and self-sufficiency rules out divine need as the basis of accompaniment.
Human need and limited means makes the relation deliberately asymmetrical.

structural_cues: 47:35 places وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ beside non-deduction; 47:36-38 then orders wages, a limited wealth demand, hypothetical pressure, and the explicit rich/poor contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies payment, limited demand, pressure, self-sufficiency, and need; I infer that these define divine withness as asymmetrical sponsorship. A live alternative is that معكم denotes aid alone and the economic sequence begins a separate topic.

changed_reading.before: God is with you as though both parties enter a mutually dependent alliance.
changed_reading.after: God's withness is asymmetrical sponsorship: the self-sufficient giver supports and pays needy agents without depending on their wealth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary in-clause sense is armistice, not a physical ladder. It remains anchored because the packet gives the ladder or means branch for the exact focus root beside explicit height language. Downstream prose should present it only as a vertical lexical image that tests the mechanism, never as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: A ladder or means of ascent supplies an external apparatus for reaching a height.
Literal elevation supplies the already-above position that makes seeking an ascent apparatus paradoxical.

changed_reading.before: The clause juxtaposes a political peace proposal with an unrelated statement of superiority.
changed_reading.after: As a contained vertical image, it warns against calling for an external means of ascent when one already occupies the upper position.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the packet's non-dominant د ع ع mapping under a surface normally read from د ع و. It remains valid as a packet-resolved branch activation attached to the exact focus word and produces a coherent changed mechanism. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory pressure-image, not a lexical gloss of تَدْعُوا.

activation_trace.role: A severe push supplies coercive momentum hidden behind what otherwise looks like verbal invitation.
Shaking a full vessel so it packs tighter supplies an image of pressing a collective into settlement.
Armistice remains the destination into which the coercive pressure is directed.

changed_reading.before: The prohibited act is merely requesting peace too timidly.
changed_reading.after: The pressure-image allows the prohibition also to test an overdriven rush that pushes or packs the group into settlement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the direct diminution branch fits the syntax more cleanly than the blood-claim branch. It remains anchored in the exact ו ت ر verb and its direct object أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ, and it preserves the affective force of losing kin, property, or right. Downstream prose should render it as personification of invested labor, not as the primary verbal sense.

activation_trace.role: Being deprived of kin, property, or right and left with a claim supplies bereavement-like force to possible loss.
Intentional deeds become the deeply invested possession whose removal would wound the worker.

changed_reading.before: The promise concerns a numerical reduction in a reward ledger.
changed_reading.after: As a contained affective image, the promise says the workers will not be bereaved of labor in which they have invested themselves.

strongest_changes: 47:4 gives war an internal endpoint, so 47:35 blocks premature, weakness-driven cessation rather than sacralizing endless conflict.
Support, fixed footing, patronage, and the failure of a stronger town recast superiority as relationally sustained rather than materially inherent.
The repeated work formulas and later wage promise turn non-deduction into conditional accounting: God does not underpay, while agents can invalidate their work.
The reversed call in 47:38 makes the focus part of competing summonses over agency, expenditure, withholding, and replaceability.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest latent activation came from exact reversals and recurrences: war itself lays its burden down, the caller becomes the called, greater force lacks support, hidden states become audible, and preserved deeds sit beside self-nullified deeds. The non-dominant coercive mapping and ladder image remain live only as contained outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The coordination can be heard either as two independent prohibitions or as a linked sequence in which weakening generates the peace call.
The closing expenditure and replacement sequence may directly reinterpret the focus summons or may only broaden its ethic by adjacency.
The ladder, coercive-push, and bereavement activations are mechanism probes rather than likely surface senses.
